newsitem.title: JAPAN: Takeda shares rise to new high for 1997.
newsitem.headline: Takeda shares rise to new high for 1997.

text.p: Shares of Takeda Chemical Industries Ltd jumped to a high for the calendar year on Monday morning as recent volatile currency movements prompted investors to buy defensive stocks, such as pharmaceuticals, traders said.
Takeda briefly hit 3,160 yen, a new high for 1997. At 0104 GMT, it was up 50 yen at 3,140. Trading volume was 1.103 million shares.
"With investors eyeing the currency market and seeking defensive stocks, shares of drug makers were bought," said a broker at a medium-sized Japanese securities house.
